Marginal and covariance formulas follow from exact algebra. value.rationale: A full joint degree law for prescribed ambient-adjacent vertices in hypercube UST is a natural finite-dimensional local statistic beyond one-point and two-edge moments. Symmetry reduces a determinant on 2d−1 edges to a fixed 3×3 determinant times a power of one quadratic, enabling exact probabilities in arbitrary dimensions. The nontrivial strictly positive degree covariance contrasts with negative covariances of distinct individual UST edges, and its sharp d²-scaled constant follows from the same law. No broad downstream application is asserted.
